dish: scallop-paste ramen (hotate paste melted into the soup)
n: Ame wa, Yasashiku No.2 (雨は、やさしくNo.2)
address: Kita 7-jō Higashi 3-chōme, Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A creative Sapporo shop whose signature bowl comes with a scallop paste you stir in as you eat. rurubu's 2025 list of local favourites includes it.

dish: Sapporo miso ramen (its own take on the classic)
w: Keeps the traditional Sapporo miso style while developing its own. One of rurubu's seven classic miso shops for 2025, and new on Ramen Adventures' Hokkaido list at #15.

n: Sapporo Menya Mitsubaki (札幌麺屋 美椿)
w: A noren-wake offshoot of a famous Sapporo shop; its miso ramen layers miso, stock and wok-fried vegetables. On rurubu's classic-seven list, and a new entry at #19 on Ramen Adventures' 2024 Hokkaido list.

dish: refined tanrei shōyu and 'evolved' miso ramen
n: Sapporo Bon no Kaze (札幌 凡の風)
address: Minami 8-jō Nishi 15-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Serves two signature bowls: a clean tanrei shōyu and a modern miso. On rurubu's 2025 local-favourites list, and new on Ramen Adventures' 2024 Hokkaido list at #21.

dish: seabura tonkotsu shōyu ramen (back-fat pork-bone soy)
n: Ramen Tetsuya Minami 7-jō Honten (らーめん てつや 南7条本店)
address: Minami 7-jō Nishi 12-chōme 2-19, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The Sapporo shop that brought rich back-fat tonkotsu shōyu to a miso city; the head branch is in southern Chuo-ku.

n: Shiawase no Recipe ~Sweet~ Susukino (幸せのレシピ～スイート～ すすきの店)
address: Big Silver Bldg B1F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 4-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A late-night parfait basement in central Susukino, open until about 2 am: seasonal parfaits built on more than 20 house-made gelato.

dish: Hokkaido-produce 'liquid cooking' cocktails (haskap & shiso; blue cheese & white chocolate)
address: Miyako Bldg 7F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 3-chōme 3-5, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A cocktail counter that treats cocktails as liquid cooking, made with seasonal fruit and vegetables bought from Hokkaido growers. Pairings include haskap with shiso, and blue cheese with white chocolate.

dish: Hokkaido-only sake flights (~300 local sake, shōchū, beer, wine) with zangi and farm cheese
n: Hokkaidō-sanshu BAR Kamada (北海道産酒BAR かま田)
address: MY Plaza Bldg 8F, Minami 4-jō Nishi 4-chōme 14-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Master sake sommelier Takashi Kamada pours only Hokkaido drinks, about 300 of them, with local bar food such as zangi and farm cheese. He speaks English.

dish: Nemuro-direct seasonal kaiten-zushi (hanasaki crab, Nemuro saury)
n: Kaiten-zushi Nemuro Hanamaru, JR Tower Stellar Place (回転寿司 根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店)
address: Sapporo Stellar Place Center 6F, Kita 5-jō Nishi 2-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Sapporo Station branch of the Nemuro conveyor-belt chain, with fish shipped direct from Nemuro. Locals rank it among the city's best kaiten-zushi, and the queues are long.
